body: Fixes #1618

comments_data.body:
Thanks @lebaphi - but the layout doesn't work as the window gets wider.
![gif](https://i.gyazo.com/9f68b320ae284fbb948f7fdae446804b.gif)

I'm probably being old fashioned, but I _guess_ it all needs to be in table.

> Thanks @lebaphi - but the layout doesn't work as the window gets wider. ![gif](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/4debdd376ca653abaf0d7b310f9d41439085cb909f9341b48d920055c875d18e/68747470733a2f2f692e6779617a6f2e636f6d2f39663638623332306165323834666262393438663766646165343436383034622e676966) [ ](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/4debdd376ca653abaf0d7b310f9d41439085cb909f9341b48d920055c875d18e/68747470733a2f2f692e6779617a6f2e636f6d2f39663638623332306165323834666262393438663766646165343436383034622e676966) ![gif](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/4debdd376ca653abaf0d7b310f9d41439085cb909f9341b48d920055c875d18e/68747470733a2f2f692e6779617a6f2e636f6d2f39663638623332306165323834666262393438663766646165343436383034622e676966) [ ](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/4debdd376ca653abaf0d7b310f9d41439085cb909f9341b48d920055c875d18e/68747470733a2f2f692e6779617a6f2e636f6d2f39663638623332306165323834666262393438663766646165343436383034622e676966) > > I'm probably being old fashioned, but I _guess_ it all needs to be in table. Yes, if it be in the table, everything goes well. The issue is the way we implement this component: content (reuse SortableList) and the header in separate places: So there is 2 solutions for this: - Refactor this component using table (style might inconsistent with others) - Keep using SortableList and try to sync position of the icon header by CSS I decided to go with 2), let me play more with this :D

> I decided to go with 2), let me play more with this :D

Sure, ok.

In the longer term, I'm happy for us to switch to an off-the-shelf component.

Thanks @lebaphi 

I'll check the fix once the deployment is ready.  But, the workaround does seem a little _fragile_.  I look forward to finding an off-the-shelf data table component.
okay, I will try with table now 😄

> okay, I will try with table now 😄

No, don't worry @lebaphi .  I don't want to invest effort in the workaround if we're going to (eventually) move to an off-the-shelf component.

issues.title: Attribute Features out of Alignment
issues.body:
In the downloadable version, the features of the attribute box seem to have left alignment with their respective text boxes/toggles:

![Attribute out of alignment](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/174678068-794a229f-a56f-4991-b688-4f65cd132e3f.png)

It'd be nice if we could realign them.

comments.body: @lebaphi  - could you center-align these icons on their columns please?
